Done! Created src/numbering.js with `nextInvoiceNumber()` and added `issueInvoice()` to src/invoices.js with 13 new tests. All 53 tests pass.

**nextInvoiceNumber()** generates INV-<year>-<counter> format, extracting the year from issueDate and restarting the 4-digit counter each year.

**issueInvoice()** assigns the next number and changes status from 'draft' to 'issued'. It rejects NOT_DRAFT status and never mutates the original invoice.
